prior_defects: Q1616 prior source locator established NKG2D hypoglycosylation but did not by itself bind the keyed N-linked glycosylation construct strongly enough.
Q1617 contained non-real/impossible transport-process distractors (carbamoyl-phosphate export and direct acetyl-CoA export).
Q1618 contained non-real/unsupported distractor mechanisms (alpha-ketoglutarate competitive inhibition and a sodium-dependent intestinal pyridoxine transporter).
repairs: Q1616 now uses separate live-frozen evidence for MAGT1-dependent N-linked glycosylation and NKG2D hypoglycosylation.
Q1617 distractors were replaced with real mitochondrial transport processes while preserving the citrin construct and key B.
Q1618 distractors were replaced with real vitamin-B6/PLP handling mechanisms while preserving the ALDH7A1/P6C construct and key C.
Q1619 and Q1620 were re-audited from zero and retained without content changes.
